sql: DELETE FROM p.d.target WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM p.d.source)
UPDATE p.d.target SET value = s.value FROM p.d.source s WHERE target.id = s.id
MERGE p.d.target t USING (SELECT id, value FROM p.d.one UNION ALL SELECT id, value FROM p.d.two) s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET value = s.value
MERGE p.d.target t USING p.d.source s ON t.id IN (SELECT id FROM p.d.lookup) WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE
ALTER TABLE p.d.target ADD COLUMN value INT64
ALTER TABLE p.d.old RENAME TO renamed
INSERT INTO p.d.target (value) VALUES ((SELECT MAX(value) FROM p.d.source))
WITH c AS (SELECT id FROM p.d.source) INSERT INTO p.d.target (id) SELECT id FROM c
INSERT INTO p.d.first (id) SELECT id FROM p.d.source; INSERT INTO p.d.second (id) SELECT id FROM p.d.first
INSERT INTO p.d.target (id) SELECT id FROM p.d.target
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp AS SELECT id FROM p.d.source; DROP TABLE tmp; SELECT 1 AS id
